top_signals.title: Kuwait Petroleum CEO Says Oil Output Tops 2 Million Barrels a Day
top_signals.summary: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation CEO Sheikh Nawaf Saud Nasir Al-Sabah says the company has kept crude deliveries to customers largely at pre-conflict levels by using alternative shipment arrangements and its strategic tanker fleet. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Futures Climb With SpaceX Results Helping Boost AI Sentiment
top_signals.summary: The S&P 500 Index touched session highs in afternoon trading on Wednesday, helped by solid earnings from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer Inc., which bolstered bullish views of the artificial-intelligence trade. Attention turns next to earnings from tech giants Meta Platforms Inc. and Tesla Inc., due after the bell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Robinhood single-stock perps could be a ‘strong positive’ for HOOD shares, Mizuho says
top_signals.summary: A Mizuho survey of 600+ Robinhood users finds 94% would trade single-stock perpetual futures, mostly with new money.
